facts.fact: ICT Minister Savannah Maziya said banks and telecoms have chosen not to use the Royal Science and Technology Park's data centre, and that the park earns money by storing data; Tier III is a long-term goal, not stated as reached.

systems.country_label: Royal Science and Technology Park data centre

facts.fact: The Royal Science and Technology Park, a parastatal, runs the data centre the ICT Minister described, which she said it aims to make Tier III and a source of revenue from storing data.

systems.country_label: Royal Science and Technology Park data centre

SWZ.note: The RSTP Act 2023 requires government departments to use RSTP for ICT needs, but hosting of state data in the data centre is not stated.
The social register is mentioned only as an example of work that would go through RSTP; none is stated as under way or in service.
A wish to host start-ups at RSTP is stated; no startup law, label or fund.

facts.fact: ICT Minister Savannah Maziya said the Royal Science and Technology Park is to be rebuilt as a hub for young innovators hosting start-ups and global tech players, the park having not yet met its founding vision.

SWZ.note: No incubation programme or cohort stated.
